description: Budgets for the Quick-native canvas contract gate (UnitTestsCanvasParity). Read fail-closed: a case with no entry here fails rather than falling back to a default. Observed measurements are written next to the test binary as canvas-parity-<case>.json and are evidence, not a baseline -- nothing in this gate can be made to pass by regenerating a golden.
pixel_units: per-channel 0-255 delta between the grabbed frame and the surface the Core renderer produced, alpha included
